notes:
**CHR-1104: design-system cleanup of the Use Cases tab** (follow-up to CHR-1062 / CHR-1103). The screens did not change visually: all 20 tagged screens and `app-shell` render byte-identical PNGs before and after.

## What changed
- **Topbar:** `uc-topbar` is gone. It is now `shell-topbar` variant `use-cases`, and the `topbar` node on all 20 Use Cases screens points to it.
- **Dialog shell:** new pattern `uc-dialog` (scrim + dialog, header, scrolling body, footer). It covers the 12 dialog screens (tag `dialog`). New tokens `size.dialog-head` (52px) and `size.dialog-foot` (60px); the header and footer of every dialog screen use them.
- **Mono field:** `chrome-field` gains `mono`, `mono-warning` and `mono-error`. 51 instances on 10 dialog screens and the 6 in `uc-step-op` styled the value slot inline as `family-code` / `ui-sm`; they now use the variant. Only a colour stays on the fill (secondary for a fixed id, tertiary for a placeholder).
- **`uc-step-op`:** the ids in its three variant templates are now unique (`ia-`, `ap-`, `rm-` prefixes). Before, the pattern failed to load (duplicate ids), so the tools skipped it and it blocked `delete_entity`.
- **Decision** `chr1104-use-case-visual-language` records the tab's visual language.

## Preview code
Nothing has to follow. The preview already has one topbar with a per-view tab state, one shared dialog builder (`usecases-dialog.js`, `.uc-dialog`) and a mono field class (`chrome-field uc-mono`).
